description: This file defines the GenericDateDisplayField class, which extends CombinedDisplayField, and manages the display and mapping of date-related fields within the OrangeHRM reporting system. It includes constants for field mappings, methods to set display fields, and getters for entity aliases and fields.

classes.name: GenericDateDisplayField
classes.description: A class representing a display field for dates in reports, mapping field aliases to entity fields and providing necessary data for report generation.

methods.name: setDisplayField
methods.description: Sets the entity alias and field based on the provided DisplayField's alias.

methods.name: setEntityAlias
methods.description: Sets the internal entity alias used for field reference.

methods.name: setField
methods.description: Sets the internal field name used for data retrieval.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the DTO class associated with this display field.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns an array containing the entity alias used in the display field.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns an array containing the field name used in the display field.
